change: Add is_reversed to the existing fail-closed guard.
hypothesis: v4d rewards a reversed lap at 208 percent of optimal because its dominant term is derived from step count alone and is blind to direction. It never reads params['is_reversed'].

reasoning: The claim was narrow: adding is_reversed to the existing fail-closed guard makes the function reject a reversed lap on its own. Evidence supports it. Reversed fell from 208 percent of optimal to 0 percent. Predicted mean on optimal was 4.1125 and measured was 4.1125, an error of 0.0 percent, which indicates the mechanism was understood rather than stumbled into. No regression: all other trajectories scored identically. The function still FAILS the gate set for a separate pre-existing defect this change did not touch, an UnboundLocalError on 106 of 214 steps, verified present in the unmodified original. CONTAMINATION NOTE: this verdict is not independent. The same party proposed and judged. A genuine fresh-context judge is required before relying on it.
